title: [proposal] Integrate handlebars as a native available template engine in html
body: ### Why a dedicated template engine ? Simply because it is better to add a template engine to html than accept unobstrusive javascript behaviors. See bellow(*) ### Why handlebars? Handlebars is a logic less template engine ported to all major programmation language. Its logicless property make it a good candidate to be integrated in a descriptor language like html. And the fact it is ported to many language make handlebars a kind of neutral template engine. * JS (client browser + server nodeJS) : https://handlebarsjs.com/ * RUST : https://github.com/sunng87/handlebars-rust * C : https://github.com/jbboehr/handlebars.c (this one can be used in linux/BSD/MacOS scripts shells !) * PHP : https://github.com/zordius/lightncandy * PYTHON: https://github.com/wbond/pybars3 * JAVA : https://github.com/jknack/handlebars.java * RUBY : https://github.com/cowboyd/handlebars.rb * OBJECTIVE C : https://github.com/Bertrand/handlebars-objc * SCALA : https://github.com/mwunsch/handlebars.scala * .NET : https://github.com/Handlebars-Net/Handlebars.Net * ... Probably others ... Moreover, since handlebars is available in many languages, implementation in web browser should be relatively easy. If you don't know handlebars, just take a look to see how it is quick and easy to learn : https://handlebarsjs.com/guide/. **The proposition** Today, we can do it ``` ``` The proposition is to be able to do it ``` ``` Then we can add some basic if statements, dynamically set attributes content... As a needed limitation all templates and scripts elements have to be escaped by the UA from the result of a template output, because a descriptive language like html have to be easily readable and must not become a programming language by itself. (But we may or may not be able to use "onload" or others "onevent" attributes, **we have to discuss here about this possibility**) (*) This proposition will be related to another propositions regarding declarative reusability of html portions. This concerns a javascript non obstrusive set of features. Please wait because the related propositions are not yet ready to be published here. But if you get time and you want an approximative idea of what I means you can take a look here https://flavi1.github.io/html-dynamic-extensions/ and here https://www.w3.org/community/blog/2023/03/07/proposed-group-declarative-dynamic-extensions-to-html-community-group/
